fixes.explanation: Prophets, huh? I see the thinking, baker, they're everywhere in this book. But Jesus says, "…just as I have received authority from My Father." (Revelation 2:27). The Father is the one who gave it, no prophet handed Him a thing.

From His people? Nope, but that's a friendly guess, baker. Jesus says, "…just as I have received authority from My Father." (Revelation 2:27). It didn't come up from the people, it came down from the Father. That's where His authority starts.
